name: Fridge map
summary: The shared fridge with its door open: every item drawn on its shelf in its owner's color, old food with stink lines, a door strip showing who takes up the space; tap to claim or toss, one button clears the mystery food.
useWhen: roommates arguing about the fridge: 'whose rice is this', 'who keeps leaving takeout'
a shared-kitchen clean-out where nobody admits to the old stuff
dontUseWhen: a grocery run or shopping list (use grocery)

params.title: string
params.items: up to 14 x {label, tag (short shelf tag), kind: carton|box|pot|cup|bottle|eggs|lemon|slice|jar, shelf 0-2, owner (name or '' for mystery), days (age), old (days until expired), count}
